title: A.P. Cognitive Twin Persona
subtitle: A new cognitive twin persona merges kernel principles, cognitive signature, and practitioner elicitation into a unified agent identity.
key_concept: A.P. is the first complete cognitive twin persona, integrating all layers of the Cathedral's architecture.
visual_metaphor: A stained glass window with four concentric rings (principles, skills, knowledge, firmware) converging into a central amber eye.
highlights: Merges 12 Kernel principles, 13 skills in 4 layers, and embodied knowledge
Includes decision firmware, vocabulary, anti-patterns, and compatibility notes
why_it_matters: Establishes a reusable cognitive twin template, enabling consistent agent identity across sessions.
zone_change: New territory: Cognitive Twin Persona added to the Agent Genome map.
